title: Integrability against the Rademacher measure
statement: Let $\mathrm{Rad} = \tfrac{1}{2}\delta_{-1} + \tfrac{1}{2}\delta_{+1}$ be the Rademacher distribution on $\bbr$. Then every function $f \colon \bbr \to \bbr$ is integrable with respect to $\mathrm{Rad}$.
hypotheses_covered: f is an arbitrary real-valued function on the reals
replaced:
For any $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$, the function $f$ is integrable with
respect to the Rademacher measure $\mathrm{Rad}$.
